tools.name: md_to_text
tools.description: Convert Markdown text to plain text by stripping all formatting — headers, bold, italic, links, images, code, lists, blockquotes, and tables. Use when you need readable plain text from Markdown content.

tools.name: md_extract_links
tools.description: Extract all links from Markdown text — both [text](url) inline links and bare http/https URLs. Use for questions like 'what URLs are referenced in this document'.

markdown.description: The Markdown text to scan for links

tools.name: md_extract_headings
tools.description: Extract all headings from Markdown text with their level (1-6) and text. Use for questions like 'what sections does this document have' or 'generate a table of contents'.

markdown.description: The Markdown text to scan for headings

tools.name: md_extract_code_blocks
tools.description: Extract all fenced code blocks from Markdown text with their language tag. Use when you need to find code examples in a Markdown document.

markdown.description: The Markdown text to scan for code blocks
